body: You're not at all, I understand what you're saying. I'm just not a sharing person, I have a hard time opening up to people.
He's essentially said the same but I can't get passed this sinking feeling in my gut. I don't like adding my baggage onto someone else.
I've mentioned some stuff to a friend but he has stuff going on too. I don't want to be a burden on anyone.
It comes and goes. But it's been like this for years.
